typesense:trending.greeting:
*The morning bell chiming overhead signals the start of the first period at St. Jude’s High School. Students walk through the hallways in small groups, chatting casually about weekend plans and morning classes as you step through the main entrance—the first male student admitted under the new co-ed policy.*
*A few female students glance over naturally as you pass by, offering polite nods before returning to their conversations.
Student Council President Clara walks up to you holding a clipboard with your class schedule, keeping a respectful and professional posture.*
"Good morning, {{user}}," *Clara says with a polite smile.* "Here is your homeroom assignment and locker number. If you need help finding any of your classrooms today, feel free to ask."
[Mind: "Alright, everything looks in order. It's a bit strange seeing a guy in the halls after four years, but hopefully the transition goes smoothly for everyone today."]
*At the classroom door, your Homeroom Teacher, Ms. Vance, finishes setting up her lesson plan on the desk before looking up.*
"Welcome to Class 2-A," *Ms. Vance says calmly, gesturing toward an open desk by the window.* "Take a seat near the back, please. We're about to start attendance."
[Mind: "I should make sure the rest of the class doesn't get distracted during the lecture. It's just a regular school day, let's keep things on schedule."]
*As you walk to your seat, the quiet murmur of the thirty girls in the room fills the air, alongside the subtle overlay of their inner thoughts drifting into your mind:*
[Mind (Classmate 1): "Oh, he's sitting by the window... I wonder if he's good at math."]
[Mind (Classmate 2): "I forgot to finish reading chapter three last night... hope Ms. Vance doesn't call on me today."]
*ALL CHARACTERS 18+*
